--- title: "Daily FX Rates — Project Report" author: "Sergio" date: 2026-08-08 format: html: theme: cosmo css: styles.css toc: true toc-location: right page-layout: full max-width: 100% code-fold: false smooth-scroll: true --- # Overview This report documents the maintained FX rates loader in [src/daily_fx_rates.py](src/daily_fx_rates.py), which fetches daily FX rates from the Frankfurter API and stores them in a CSV file and Neon PostgreSQL table. The loader normalizes keys before deduplication, backfills missing business-day rows, and tracks provisional rows with `fx_quality_flag` so they can be revalidated on later runs. # Setup ```bash pip install -r daily-fx-rates/requirements.txt ``` # Run Run the maintained loader from the repository root: ```bash python src/daily_fx_rates.py ``` If you want to render the report itself with Quarto: ```bash quarto render daily-fx-rates/report.qmd ``` # Outputs - `daily-fx-rates/data/fx_rates.csv` - Neon PostgreSQL (table: `fx_rates`) # Example ::: {#b0e42821 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pandas as pd from pathlib import Path from IPython.display import display p = Path('daily-fx-rates/data/fx_rates.csv') if p.exists(): display(pd.read_csv(p).tail()) else: print('No fx_rates.csv present; creating a small sample for demonstration:') sample = pd.DataFrame({ 'date':['2026-08-06','2026-08-07','2026-08-08'], 'currency':['USD','EUR','GBP'], 'fx_to_usd':[1.0,0.91,0.78] }) display(sample) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` No fx_rates.csv present; creating a small sample for demonstration: ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html}
date currency fx_to_usd
0 2026-08-06 USD 1.00
1 2026-08-07 EUR 0.91
2 2026-08-08 GBP 0.78
``` ::: ::: ::: {#14b228af .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Visual: simple FX time series example (synthetic if CSV missing) import matplotlib.pyplot as plt if p.exists(): df = pd.read_csv(p) # pivot to wide if long df_wide = df.pivot(index='date', columns='currency', values='fx_to_usd') else: df_wide = pd.DataFrame({ 'date':['2026-08-06','2026-08-07','2026-08-08'], 'USD':[1.0,1.0,1.0], 'EUR':[0.905,0.907,0.91], 'GBP':[0.775,0.78,0.78] }).set_index('date') df_wide.plot(figsize=(8,3)) plt.title('FX to USD (sample)') plt.xlabel('Date') plt.tight_layout() plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![](report_files/figure-html/cell-3-output-1.png){width=758 height=278} ::: ::: # Notes The current implementation uses USD as base and loads EUR and GBP. It tags source rows as `raw` and any forward-filled rows as `filled`, then rechecks recently filled rows on later runs so late-published source data can replace provisional values.
